## Change

Describe what changed and why.

## Testing

State the automated checks and browser tests actually performed. Note anything not tested.

## Review

- [ ] No real student/account data, page dumps, credentials, or session tokens are included.
- [ ] Permissions, URL scope, storage, and network changes are documented, or this change does not affect them.
- [ ] Relevant tests were run, or the reason they were not run is stated above.
- [ ] Documentation and version/changelog updates are included when applicable.
